100-verification__workflow-verify-review.name: verify-reviews
100-verification__workflow-verify-review.description:
Agent code reviews using claude CLI directly. Detects changed files,
constructs review prompts with the diff inlined, and runs claude -p
for each review type in parallel. Runs on the host in a fresh git
worktree so CLAUDE.md, skills, and file reads reflect the verified commit.

jobs.name: setup
jobs.description: Create a clean worktree at the verified commit.

inputs.run:
set -e
# Concurrent verifications share refs/remotes/origin/main; the
# loser of the ref update fails with "incorrect old value".
# The retry finds the ref current, so it has nothing to write.
git fetch origin main || { sleep 1; git fetch origin main; }
CHECKOUT_DIR="/tmp/swamp-verify-reviews-${{ run.id }}"
rm -rf "$CHECKOUT_DIR"
git worktree prune
git worktree add --detach "$CHECKOUT_DIR" "${{ inputs.commit }}"
swamp repo init "$CHECKOUT_DIR"
# init prepends a managed section to CLAUDE.md and .gitignore;
# restore them so only the branch's own changes reach the diff.
git -C "$CHECKOUT_DIR" checkout -- .

jobs.name: detect-changes
jobs.description: Compute the merge-base diff and changed file list.

jobs.name: reviews
jobs.description: Run all agent reviews in parallel using claude CLI.

inputs.run:
set -o pipefail
MERGE_BASE=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)
DIFF_FILE=$(mktemp)
PROMPT_FILE=$(mktemp)
RESULT_FILE=$(mktemp)
git diff "$MERGE_BASE" > "$DIFF_FILE"
cat verification/review-prompts/code-review.md > "$PROMPT_FILE"
printf '\n\nThe diff to review is at: %s\nRead that file to see the changes.\n\nIMPORTANT: You MUST begin your response with exactly one of these two lines:\nVERDICT: pass\nVERDICT: fail\n\nThen provide your full review below the verdict line.\n' "$DIFF_FILE" >> "$PROMPT_FILE"
claude -p - \
  --model claude-opus-5-5 \
  --allowedTools "Read,Glob,Grep" < "$PROMPT_FILE" | tee "$RESULT_FILE"
CLAUDE_EXIT=$?
rm -f "$PROMPT_FILE" "$DIFF_FILE"
if [ $CLAUDE_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::claude exited with status $CLAUDE_EXIT"
  rm -f "$RESULT_FILE"
  exit 1
fi
deno run --allow-read="$RESULT_FILE" \
  scripts/check_review_verdict.ts "$RESULT_FILE" "Code review"
VERDICT_EXIT=$?
rm -f "$RESULT_FILE"
exit $VERDICT_EXIT
